per_credit_hour_charges.line: Argo Connect allows students to take up to three 3-credit courses at no cost. All remaining courses will be $55 per credit.
Step 5:  Submit your in-full tuition payment ($55/Credit) to student accounts. Instructions will be provided after steps 1 – 4 are complete.

Students in the Argo Connect program will pay $55 per credit in addition to any associated program fees. All students will be required to pay tuition in full at the time of registration and will not be eligible to receive financial aid.
